preconditions.description: The number of time-steps is at least 1 and at most 200.
The number of queries is at least 2 and at most 10^5.
The operation type is either 1 or 2.
The maximum number of times the operation can be applied is at most m.
The multiplier for type 1 operations is at most 10^5 * m.
The multiplier for type 2 operations is greater than 10^5 and at most 10^5 * m.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or output[i] > 0 for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each output value is -1 if it is impossible to obtain exactly i bananas, or a positive integer if it is possible.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] <= output[j] for i < j if output[i] != -1 and output[j] != -1)
postconditions.description: For any two distinct indices i and j where both values are not -1, the earlier time-step is preferred.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or exists(j for j in range(n) if can_create_j_bananas(j, i)) for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: For each possible number of bananas, there exists a sequence of operations that can produce exactly that number of bananas.
